rules.rule: If the lord of a house and the house be both powerful, the objects signified are promoted; if weak, reduced
Benefics promote a bhava and malefics reduce it — reversed for the 6th, 8th and 12th
Dignity grading of the occupant: exalted = full, moolatrikona = 3/4, own = 1/2, friendly = 1/4, inimical < 1/4, debilitated or combust = nil
Kendras are naturally powerful; biped signs by day, quadruped by night, centipede at dawn and dusk

notes: Significations Ch 1 v15; names v16; classes v18-19; benefic/malefic and dignity grading Ch 20 v10-11.
